fact.thing: calendar days before and after the sale in the superficial loss window
fact.box: Crypto held in a regular taxable (non-registered) account, reported on Schedule 3
fact.claim: If you sell crypto at a loss, the CRA treats it as a superficial loss when you, or a person affiliated with you such as a spouse, buy the same or identical property in the period from 30 calendar days before the sale to 30 calendar days after it, and you still own it 30 days after the sale. You can't deduct a superficial loss that year, but the CRA does not erase it. The loss is usually added to the adjusted cost base of the coin you bought back, so it lowers the gain or raises the loss when you sell that coin later. For 2025 the capital gains inclusion rate is 50%, which means half of a capital loss can be applied against taxable capital gains. The CRA guide only covers 2025, and no year-end settlement cutoff date for 2026 on any crypto platform could be confirmed on a primary source.

sources.label: CRA, CAPITAL LOSSES
sources.what: You, or a person affiliated with you, buys, or has a right to buy, the same or identical property (called "substituted property") during the period starting 30 calendar days before the sale and ending 30 calendar days after the sale

sources.label: CRA T4037 CAPITAL GAINS 2025
sources.what: First, you must determine if the gains or losses from disposing crypto-assets are from conducting a business in the trading of crypto-assets or on account of capital. If the disposition is on account of capital, you may have a capital gain or capital loss.

plain.what: Say you sell some bitcoin for less than you paid. Bitcoin is digital money you buy, hold, and sell, and selling it for less than you paid is a loss. If you, or your spouse, buy that same coin back in the 30 days before or after the sale and still hold it 30 days later, the CRA calls it a superficial loss and you can't claim it this year.
plain.so_what: For 2025 only half of a loss counts, so a clean $1,000 loss lets $500 go against your taxable gains, while a superficial loss gives you none of that this year.
plain.do: Write down the dates of every coin buy you made in the last 30 days.
